entries.sense_en: very fine and impressive to look at

synonyms.nuance: Stronger and grander; suits palaces, views and great performances more than a toy.
Everyday word for anything very pleasant; says nothing about appearance in particular.
Informal and warm; mostly about beauty of people, clothes or weather.

entries.tip_ko: splendid는 영국식 대화에서 '좋아요!'(Splendid!)라는 감탄으로도 자주 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: pushed tightly into a narrow space so that it cannot move

synonyms.nuance: Stresses the effort of pushing into a tight space; the thing may still move afterwards.
Forceful and often careless; the result is stuck or blocked.
Pushing soft things in loosely and quickly, often too many.

entries.sense_en: a small stem with leaves, cut from a plant

synonyms.nuance: A small thin piece of a branch, usually bare and woody, not for decoration.
Much bigger; an arm growing from a tree trunk.
A small bunch of flowers or leaves on one stem, used for decoration.

entries.sense_en: the soft, dry sound of paper or leaves moving

synonyms.nuance: Sharper, repeated snapping sounds, like a fire or dry plastic.
Figurative for a very soft sound; gentler and quieter than rustling.
A loud sound of something being crushed, like steps on gravel or snow.

entries.sense_en: a thing wrapped in paper, here a wrapped present

synonyms.nuance: The usual American word; British English also uses it for boxes sent by post.
synonyms.example: a package from the post office

synonyms.nuance: Several things tied together loosely, not neatly wrapped.
A small container of a product, like sugar or seeds.

entries.tip_ko: 미국에서는 package, 영국에서는 parcel을 더 흔히 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: treated someone coldly on purpose, as if they were not important

synonyms.nuance: Simply pay no attention; not always meant as an insult.
Informal; a longer, deliberate unfriendliness toward someone you know.
Describes the attitude of feeling superior, not a single act of rudeness.

entries.sense_en: behaving as if you are better than other people

synonyms.nuance: Stronger and harsher; openly proud and rude.
Talking to others as if they were less clever; focuses on the tone used.
Looking down on people of lower class or taste.

entries.tip_ko: '우월한'이라는 뜻 외에, 사람의 태도를 말할 때는 '잘난 척하는'이라는 부정적 의미가 된다.

entries.sense_en: thought that others were less important or less good than you

synonyms.nuance: Much stronger; real hatred and disgust.
Showing contempt openly, often in words.
Thinking someone is weaker or less able than they are; no pride involved.

entries.sense_en: the ropes and chains that hold up a ship's masts and sails

synonyms.nuance: Ropes and pulleys for lifting; also general equipment, as in fishing tackle.
General word for the tools needed for any job.
Only the tall pole that holds the sails, not the ropes.
synonyms.example: The mast snapped in the storm.

entries.sense_en: acted as if more important or elegant than one really is

synonyms.nuance: Doing things to make others admire you; more active and childish.
synonyms.example: He was showing off his new car.

synonyms.nuance: Same meaning; slightly more old-fashioned.
synonyms.example: She gives herself airs since the promotion.

synonyms.nuance: Talking proudly about yourself; putting on airs is more about manner.

entries.sense_en: small and unimportant, not worth noticing

synonyms.nuance: Of little importance; used for matters and problems, rarely for people.
Neutral; smaller or less serious than others.
So small it can be ignored; used for amounts.

entries.sense_en: ordinary and not special in any way

synonyms.nuance: Neutral word for normal, not special.
Boring because it is part of daily routine.
Happening often or found in many places; not necessarily dull.

entries.sense_en: the line where two pieces of cloth are sewn together

synonyms.nuance: One single loop of thread; a seam is made of many stitches.
The folded, sewn edge at the bottom of clothing.
synonyms.example: take up the hem of a skirt

synonyms.nuance: A place where two parts meet, in objects or the body.

entries.sense_en: a number of things coming one after another

synonyms.nuance: Things of the same kind in order, often planned.
Order matters; each follows logically from the one before.
Informal; many similar things, often bad, happening close together.

entries.sense_en: to walk or behave in a very proud, showy way

synonyms.nuance: Walking stiffly and proudly, chest out; only about walking.
Only about talking proudly, not about movement.
Informal; any action meant to impress people.

entries.sense_en: after some time; eventually

synonyms.nuance: Modern, neutral; after a long time or many steps.
Soon; stresses a short wait.
Gradually, as time passes.

entries.sense_en: the main coiled spring that makes a clockwork toy or watch go

synonyms.nuance: General word for any coil of wire that bounces back.
The whole wind-up mechanism, not one part.
Figurative: the main cause behind something.
synonyms.example: She was the driving force behind the plan.

entries.sense_en: a low metal frame around a fireplace that keeps coals from falling out
entries.sense_ko: (벽난로 앞의) 낮은 쇠 울타리, 난로 가드

synonyms.nuance: A taller screen in front of a fire to protect people, especially children.
The stone floor of the fireplace itself; also used for 'home'.
In American English fender is part of a car; bumper is the bar at front and back.

entries.tip_ko: 미국 영어에서 fender는 보통 자동차 바퀴 덮개(흙받기)를 뜻한다.

entries.sense_en: old and worn from long use

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; damaged a little by use.
Cloth so worn the threads show; more extreme.
Untidy and dirty, usually about a person's look.

entries.sense_en: wanted something very much, often something hard to get

synonyms.nuance: Weaker and more general; often for something unlikely.
Even more emotional and literary; a deep, sad wanting.
Strong physical or emotional need, often for food.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사 long(긴)과 철자가 같지만 동사 long for/to는 '몹시 바라다'이다.

entries.sense_en: rushing about suddenly and fast, like a bird diving down on something

synonyms.nuance: Jumping suddenly on something to catch it, like a cat.
synonyms.example: The cat pounced on the mouse.

synonyms.nuance: Going straight down fast, often head first.
Moving quickly and smoothly across a wide area.

entries.sense_en: pushed something quickly and roughly somewhere

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; just moving fast, without force.
A single rough push.
Put someone somewhere quickly and without care.
synonyms.example: They bundled him into a car.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 구어의 hustle은 '열심히 일하다, 사기 치다'란 뜻도 있지만 여기서는 '밀어 넣다'이다.

entries.sense_en: almost not; only just

synonyms.nuance: The everyday equivalent; same meaning, less formal.
Stresses 'only just enough'.
About frequency (not often), not about degree.

entries.tip_ko: scarcely 자체에 부정 의미가 있으므로 not과 함께 쓰지 않는다.

entries.sense_en: the shelf above a fireplace

synonyms.nuance: Shorter form, more common in American English.
Any flat board for putting things on.
The floor of the fireplace, not the shelf above it.

entries.sense_en: a hole or tunnel in the ground where a rabbit or other animal lives

synonyms.nuance: The home of a wild animal like a fox or bear; not always underground.
Any opening or hollow; the most general word.
A bird's home built of twigs; also any cosy place.

entries.sense_en: to lie close and comfortably against someone or into something warm

synonyms.nuance: Holding each other lovingly in your arms.
Settling into a sheltered, comfortable place; more gentle and literary.
synonyms.example: a village nestled in the hills

synonyms.nuance: Lying with your body bent into a ball.

entries.sense_en: the time in the evening just after the sun goes down

synonyms.nuance: The soft light itself, at dawn or dusk; more poetic.
The moment the sun goes down; dusk comes a little after.
The moment it becomes fully dark.

entries.sense_en: complained in a low, bad-tempered voice

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, general word; may be loud or formal.
Speaking quietly and unclearly; not always a complaint.
Informal British; complaining in an annoying, whining way.

entries.sense_en: used to show surprise or mild disapproval: 'just imagine!'

synonyms.nuance: Modern equivalent: 'Imagine that!'
Fixed old-fashioned phrase of surprise.
Informal modern surprise, with no disapproval.

entries.tip_ko: Fancy + 명사/-ing 는 '~라니 (놀랍다)'라는 뜻의 영국식 옛 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: too much excitement or worry about something unimportant

synonyms.nuance: Noisy, confused activity involving many people.
Trouble or effort; milder, often in 'no bother'.
Informal; exaggerated emotional reaction.

entries.tip_ko: make a fuss about ~ (~로 법석을 떨다) 형태로 자주 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: an old-fashioned way to show surprise

synonyms.nuance: Old-fashioned British exclamation of surprise.
Mild surprise, still used today.
Modern; can show surprise or annoyance.

entries.sense_en: showing that you understand more than others think you do

synonyms.nuance: Having good judgment from experience; a lasting quality.
A look that carries a hidden message.
Clever at judging people and situations, often for advantage.

entries.sense_en: a member of a gang that robs travelers in wild country

synonyms.nuance: The common modern word for the same thing.
General word for anyone who steals by force.
A robber at sea.

entries.sense_en: a large wild fern that grows thickly in woods

synonyms.nuance: Any plant of this leafy family; bracken is one tall wild kind.
All the low plants and bushes under the trees.
A dense group of bushes or small trees.

entries.sense_en: moving in one direction and then back again, many times

synonyms.nuance: The everyday modern phrase for the same movement.
Along a line such as a street or room, often restlessly.
In various places, not a repeated movement.

entries.sense_en: strange or unusual

synonyms.nuance: Neutral modern word for unusual.
Slightly strange; light and informal.
Strange in a way that is hard to explain; a bit formal.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 queer는 주로 성소수자를 가리키므로 '이상한'의 뜻으로는 쓰지 않는 것이 좋다.

entries.sense_en: making small, quick movements

synonyms.nuance: A sudden, stronger single movement.
Moving from side to side, often on purpose and playfully.
Shaking slightly all over from fear, cold or emotion.

entries.sense_en: clearly, as you can tell from what you see

synonyms.nuance: Stronger and more everyday; anyone could see it.
Based on what you heard or what seems true; less certain.
Neutral; plainly true.

entries.sense_en: made small lines or folds appear by pulling the skin together

synonyms.nuance: Making a sharp fold line, usually in paper or cloth.
Tightening your face or eyes, often in dislike.
Only the forehead and eyebrows, showing anger or thought.

entries.tip_ko: wrinkle one's nose = (싫거나 이상해서) 코를 찡그리다.

entries.sense_en: after a short time; soon

synonyms.nuance: Everyday modern word; same meaning.
A little formal; 'in a short time'.
Means 'now'; presently can also mean this in American English.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 미국 영어에서 presently는 주로 '현재'를 뜻하지만, 옛글에서는 '곧'이다.

entries.sense_en: flew with quick, light movements of the wings

synonyms.nuance: Bigger, slower wing movements; can be noisy.
synonyms.example: The flag flapped in the wind.

synonyms.nuance: Moving quickly and lightly from place to place.
Staying in one place in the air.

entries.sense_en: red in the face, here because of fever

synonyms.nuance: Plain description; often from embarrassment or effort.
Turning red from shyness or shame, not illness.
Having a fever; describes the illness, not just the colour.

entries.sense_en: moved slightly

synonyms.nuance: General word for any change of position.
Move even a little; used mostly with 'not', often for stubborn things.
Keep making small restless movements.

entries.tip_ko: stir는 '젓다'가 기본 뜻이지만 never stirred처럼 쓰면 '꼼짝도 않다'가 된다.

entries.sense_en: long and tiring

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for something that makes you tired.
Boring because it is slow and repetitive.
Much stronger; uses up all your energy.

entries.sense_en: a group of bushes or small plants growing very close together

synonyms.nuance: A single low woody plant.
All the low plants under trees in a forest.
A row of bushes planted as a wall.

entries.sense_en: cleaned with chemicals to kill germs

synonyms.nuance: Killing all germs completely, usually with heat; medical.
Cleaning to a safe level; common for hands and surfaces.
General word; does not always kill germs.

entries.sense_en: to deal with or take care of something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and neutral; handle a problem or task.
Informal; make sure something gets done, often personally.
Common; also means looking after people.

entries.tip_ko: attend a meeting(참석하다)과 달리 attend to는 '처리하다, 돌보다'이다.

entries.sense_en: twisting and turning the body with small quick movements

synonyms.nuance: Wriggling because of discomfort or embarrassment.
Lighter and more playful movement from side to side.
Turning one part round; not necessarily repeated.

entries.sense_en: so worn that the threads can be seen

synonyms.nuance: Old and worn-looking in general; less extreme.
So used it no longer works or is useful.
Torn, with loose edges; about clothes or people.

entries.sense_en: from a time in the past

synonyms.nuance: Neutral everyday word.
About what someone or something used to be.
Only in 'the olden days'; old-fashioned, childlike.

entries.tip_ko: let bygones be bygones = 지난 일은 잊자.

entries.sense_en: flowed slowly in a thin line or drops

synonyms.nuance: Falling one drop at a time.
Flowing a lot, continuously.
Passing slowly through small holes or cracks.

entries.sense_en: thin in a graceful, attractive way

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for attractively thin, mostly for people.
Neutral; can be negative for people.
Informal and often negative; too thin.

entries.sense_en: an open grassy space in a forest

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for an open space in a forest, natural or cut; 'glade' is more poetic.
A field of grass and flowers, not inside a forest.
A small group of trees, not an open space.

entries.sense_en: dull, dirty and faded in colour

synonyms.nuance: Dull and boring in colour, but not dirty.
Covered with a layer of dirt.
Colour grown pale with age or sun.

entries.tip_ko: dingy /ˈdɪndʒi/는 'ㅈ' 소리. 작은 보트 dinghy /ˈdɪŋi/와 혼동 주의.

entries.sense_en: short grass and the soil it grows in

synonyms.nuance: A grass area kept short, usually in a garden.
The plant itself; the most general word.
A piece of turf cut out; American usage.

entries.sense_en: looked quickly and secretly

synonyms.nuance: Very close; a quick look, often playful (peekaboo).
A quick look, not secret.
Watching secretly for information; negative.
